author: gyalchester
body:
IGN: lolew
Discord(ex. Name#1234): lolew#1538
Timezone: AEST (UTC+10)
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I would like the join the referee team so that i can help the community through having better, fairer and a more enjoyable experience while playing tournaments. I would also like to try and improve the team by listening to constructive criticism given by the community and putting it into action with anything to do in this area of Avicus. I also really enjoy this server and i would like to become more engaged with it through every way possible.
Best time of the week?: Right now i am on holidays so for the next three weeks i am free almost 100% of the time but when it ends, the weekends (almost anytime on the weekends) .
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): My name is Pieter and i am originally from South Africa but moved and was raised in Australia. I am 14 years old and love school, anything computer hardware and sports. I enjoy being part of communities and helping others as this was the way i was raised. My favorite server is Avicus but close by is any potpvp server and hcf servers. I play volleyball and football (soccer) and are quite good at both. I am a team player and try to be as fair as i possibly can be, whenever i can i would try and help people to the best of my ability. 
Anything else?: Thank you for the chance to apply, if i am accepted, thank you and i will try to be as helpful as possible but if i am denied, thank you for considering my application and i hope that you made the correct decisions in improving the referee team.
